key_data.text: Apply this recommendation only when ALL requirements hold: The answer must be YES: Is the disease status localized (no known regional or distant metastasis)? AND The answer must be NO: Is the lesion considered resectable with surgery (technically operable)? AND The answer must be YES: Is prior surgery already performed with recurrent local tumor now present? AND The answer must be NO: Is additional surgical resection for recurrent tumor feasible? AND The answer must be YES: Has radiation therapy been previously delivered to the recurrent tumor site?. Recommendation: Recurrent, unresectable tumor with prior RT: consider systemic imatinib mesylate or other palliative/systemic options; maintain close clinical follow-up.
